purpose: Deterministic, hand-computed verification of src/awq_calibration.py's ActivationStats + register_activation_hooks/remove_hooks, before running it on a real model.

test_setup.deliberate_design: Linear layer weight set to +-100 (wildly different from input stats) so that if the hook accidentally captured `output` instead of `inputs[0]`, the test would fail loudly instead of silently passing -- this is the exact input-vs-output mistake project_plan_v9.md flags as easy to get backwards.

scenarios: mean_abs() on zero samples raises ValueError
run_environment: user's own .venv (torch required; sandboxed device_bash has no torch/cannot resolve the venv's python symlink)
next_step: scripts/p2_awq_activation_stats.py -- run the same hook-based collector against the real target model (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct) and real C4 calibration data. Start with --dry-run --n-samples 8, then a small real run, then the full n_samples=128 default.
